title: THE CROWD
visual_hook: Thousands of separate market voices become a single living constellation.

scenes.visual: Dark cinematic trading desk. Multiple market screens flicker with contradictory green/red price movement and blurred analyst clips.
scenes.voiceover: Buy. Sell. Breakout. Crash. Every screen has an opinion.

scenes.visual: Dozens of floating trade signals orbit the trader and collide like shards of glass.
scenes.voiceover: And the louder the feed gets, the harder it is to know what actually matters.

scenes.visual: Everything freezes. Black screen. A single point of light appears, followed by thousands of faint points converging.
scenes.voiceover: What if you stopped following one voice... and looked for the signal shared by many informed voices?

scenes.visual: Thousands of luminous trader nodes converge into a clean market map. A CrowdWisdom-style insight card emerges with entry, targets and stops represented visually.
scenes.camera: Crane out from node to network
scenes.voiceover: CrowdWisdom aggregates insights from thousands of traders and investors to reveal where the crowd is converging.

scenes.visual: Market chart moves through a controlled sequence. The insight card remains anchored while irrelevant signals fade away.
scenes.voiceover: Less noise. More context. A structured view of entries, targets, stops and market sentiment.

scenes.visual: Return to the trader. The room is calm. One screen glows while the rest of the screens are dark.
scenes.voiceover: You don't need another prediction. You need a clearer way to see the signal.
